description: 「臺北防災 立即go」防災手冊 [fire, police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺北市政府消防局. 有鑑於日本東京發行的「東京防災」手冊，本局意識到要提升民眾對災害風險的認知，首先必需改善與民眾溝通的方式，故本局致力改進生硬無趣的宣導文宣，以消除溝通上的障礙為目標，採取最有效率的溝通方式，進而達成宣導效益。 全國首創文青風「臺北防災 立即go」漫畫防災手冊，首度與畫家郭正宏先生合作，用一般民眾視角切入，實際到消防分隊模擬各種防災避災動作... Coverage: 臺北市政府消防局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺北市政府消防局. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-07-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
